params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mel's''' {{tip|basic attacks}}<!--not on-hit--> and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Overwhelm'' for each instance of damage they deal to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on {{tt|subsequent damage instances|From her attacks/abilities}} and stacking infinitely.
params.description2: {{sbc|Overwhelm:}} Store {{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50;60;70;80|0 to 3|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 10% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} on the affected enemy with the first stack, reduced{{ft|to 50%|to {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|50*0.5;60*0.5;70*0.5;80*0.5|0 to 3}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|10*0.5}}% AP)}}}}against {{tip|minions}}. For each stack, store an additional {{pp|type=[[File:Golden Eclipse.png|20px|border]] Golden Eclipse's rank|2;3;4;5|0 to 3|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.75}}% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} on the target. If the total {{tt|post-mitigation damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} stored exceeds the target's {{as|'''current''' health}} and {{tip|shields}}, the next stack applied against them will consume them all to deal the stored damage.
params.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Searing Brilliance:}} '''Mel's''' ability casts each generate 3 stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of ''Searing Brilliance'' to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target. Each projectile deals {{as|{{pplevel|8 to 30}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 4% AP)}} {{as|magic damage}}, for a total possible damage of {{as|{{pplevel|8*9 to 30*9}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*9}}% AP)}} at maximum stacks.
params.notes:
* Effects that inherit properties from the origin basic attack (e.g {{ii|Runaan's Hurricane}}) will also be able to apply ''Overwhelm'' stacks.
** Effects that apply {{tip|on-hit|on-hits}} (e.g {{ii|Guinsoo's Rageblade}}) will not apply stacks.
* The first stack also benefits from the per-stack bonus stored damage.
* A threshold indicator for the currently stored damage is placed on a target's [[health bar]], as well as a mark above their head, while any ''Overwhelm'' stacks are active. These are visible to '''Mel''' and her target(s).
** Whenever {{ais|Golden Eclipse|Mel}} damage would put them below ''Overwhelm's'' threshold, the mark will darken and glow more prominently.
*** This does not take into account effects that would amplify the damage such as {{ri|Coup de Grace}}.
* Just before ''Overwhelm'' stacks are consumed, targets have 5 additional stacks applied to them.{{bug}}
** These stacks are consumed immediately.
* ''Overwhelm'' stacks will '''not''' be consumed against {{cai|Undying Rage|Tryndamere}}.
<!-- Blurb -->
params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Overwhelm:}} {{cis|Mel}} damaging {{tip|basic attacks}} and {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Overwhelm'' to enemies hit for a few seconds, stacking infinitely. Each stack stores {{as|magic damage}}; if the total stored damage would kill the target, the next stack will consume them all to detonate the damage.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Mel's''' ability casts each generate stacks for a few seconds, up to a cap. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks to additionally fire an equal number of bolts dealing {{as|magic damage}}.

description.plain: Innate: Mel's basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Overwhelm for each instance of damage they deal to enemies for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent damage instances and stacking infinitely.

description2.plain: Overwhelm: Store 50 / 60 / 70 / 80 (based on Golden Eclipse's rank) (+ 10% AP) magic damage on the affected enemy with the first stack, reduced to 50% against minions. For each stack, store an additional 2 / 3 / 4 / 5 (based on Golden Eclipse's rank) (+ 0.75% AP) magic damage on the target. If the total post-mitigation damage stored exceeds the target's current health and shields, the next stack applied against them will consume them all to deal the stored damage.

description3.plain: Innate - Searing Brilliance: Mel's ability casts each generate 3 stacks of Searing Brilliance for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent casts and stacking up to 9 times. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks of Searing Brilliance to additionally fire an equal number of blazing projectiles at the target. Each projectile deals 8 – 30 (based on level) (+ 4% AP) magic damage, for a total possible damage of 72 – 270 (based on level) (+ 36% AP) at maximum stacks.

blurb.plain: Innate - Overwhelm: Mel damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Overwhelm to enemies hit for a few seconds, stacking infinitely. Each stack stores magic damage; if the total stored damage would kill the target, the next stack will consume them all to detonate the damage.

blurb2.plain: Innate: Mel's ability casts each generate stacks for a few seconds, up to a cap. Her next basic attack consumes all stacks to additionally fire an equal number of bolts dealing magic damage.

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' launches a barrage of luminous bolts at the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Time between first and last explosion}} which distribute evenly in the area. Each bolt explodes upon landing to deal {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, with all explosions after the first dealing reduced damage.
params.description2: The bolts momentarily grant {{tip|sight}} during their travel, while the explosions grant {{tip|sight}} over their target area. Both can see through {{tip|brush}} and [[terrain]].
params.effect radius: {{dv|{{tt|200|Explosion radius}}|{{tip|sight|icononly=true}}{{tt|100|Bolt sight radius}}}}<!-- / {{tt|?|Explosion sight radius, seems to be smaller than the explosion radius}}-->
params.notes:
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single explosion.
* For the given number of ''Radiant Volley'' bolts, the spread will result in the same individual areas being affected over the duration '''invariably'''.
** Each individual missile is explicitly assigned an explosion location at a small offset from the cast location. This varies by missile, which results in their combined area of effect distributing over a total radius of [explosion radius + maximum spread] = 200 + 50 = 250 units.
*** This means that the distribution area is not random.
*** The order of bolts however, which will determine the order of individual areas to be affected per explosion, ''is'' random.
**** '''Mel''' launching the missiles in the same arcing motion for every ''Radiant Volley'' cast does not correlate with which missile is being fired at the time. The height and gravity of each missile are irrelevant.
*** Note that the combined area of effect may not always be the maximum possible (circle with radius of 250 units); this drawback diminishes with a higher number of bolts as the new missiles fill the gaps within.
{{Effect at cast time end}}

params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Mel''' forms a protective barrier around herself for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, granting herself a {{tip|shield}} for the duration, and gaining {{as|{{sti|40% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} that decays over {{fd|0.75}} seconds. Additionally, all hostile {{tip|projectiles}} sourced from enemy {{tip|champions}} that collide with the barrier will be destroyed instantly before '''Mel''' fires the same projectiles as her own, either toward or in the direction of the {{tt|original sources|See notes}}, or {{tt|toward herself|See notes}}.
params.description2: Replicated projectiles have the {{tt|same features|See notes}} that the original ones do, but they retain a ratio of the damage that the original ones would deal. Additionally, all of their damage is converted to {{as|magic damage}}, with {{as|physical damage}} instances being reduced to 70% before conversion.
params.leveling2: {{st|Replicated Projectile Magic Damage Modifier|{{ap|40 to 60}}% {{as|(+ 5% per 100 AP)}} of the original damage|Replicated Projectile Physical Damage Modifier|{{ap|40*.7 to 60*.7}}% {{as|(+ {{ap|5*.7}}% per 100 AP)}} of the original damage}}
params.notes: * ''Rebuttal's'' barrier will also instantly destroy missiles that are already within its radius when the ability is cast. * The replicated missile will mimic all of the original missile's properties, which includes its range, width, speed, acceleration, angle (if a cone), height, and sight radius. ** Spell effects, as well as interactions with {{tip|spell shield}} and {{tip|projectile|projectile-interception}} effects, all vary based on the original missile that was replicated. ** The only exception to this is the copied missile's path, or trajectory, which is based on the [[targeting|targeting paradigm]] that the original missile used when fired by its source. The replicated missile acquires the original missile source as the target. *** If the original missile was fired by a {{tip|unit-targeted|unit}} or {{tip|auto-targeted}} effect, the replicated missile will be fired as a homing missile with the target being the original missile source. **** Healing projectiles, such as {{cai|Starcall|Soraka|Rejuvenation}} and {{cai|Aria of Perseverance|Sona}}, will instead target '''Mel'''. *** If the original missile was fired via any other targeting paradigm, the replicated missile will by default fire in the direction of the original missile source at the time of replication. This includes {{tip|vector-targeted}} projectiles (currently only {{cai|Hextech Ray|Viktor}}), for which the origin will always be '''Mel's''' center (since she cannot control the cast point). * The replicated missile will mimic all of the functions of and copy the behavior of the original missile, unless otherwise stated. This includes every aspect and effect of the missile conforming to the attack or spell from which the missile originated. ** The scaling of the effects of the copied missile is calculated using the original missile source's attributes (namely their [[champion statistic|stats]]). The damage of the missile only benefits from '''Mel's''' [[damage modifier]]s and [[magic penetration]], and not the original source's. * The following missiles are destroyed, but not replicated: ** {{cai|Whirling Death|Draven}} on its way back to him. ** {{cai|Boomerang Throw|Gnar}} on its way back to him. ** {{cai|Test of Spirit|Illaoi}} ** {{cai|Boomerang Blade|Sivir}} on its way back to her. ** {{cai|Hijack|Sylas}} ** {{cai|Fear Beyond Death 2|Urgot|Mercy}} ** {{cai|Bladecaller|Xayah}} and {{ai|Featherstorm|Xayah}} ** {{cai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}} ** Missiles fired from [[auto-targeted]] abilities that target each unit in an area and aren't targeting '''Mel'''. *** Examples include {{cai|R|Brand}}, {{cai|R|Katarina}}, {{cai|R|Samira}}, and {{cai|E|Ryze}}. * The following abilities will be stopped short of their trajectory without replication: ** {{cai|Emperor's Divide|Azir}} ** {{cai|Dark Sphere|Syndra|Spheres}} thrown with her {{ai|Scatter the Weak|Syndra}} * '''Mel''' may occasionally fail to attribute {{iis|Echoes of Helia}} {{nies|Soul Siphon}} damage projectile to herself.{{bug}} ** This can cause the enemy to be able to kill their own allies, and gain all the kill's [[Kill#Rewards|rewards]]. * ''Rebuttal'' will play distinct sound cues from destroying and replicating projectiles fired from specific types of abilities: ** Non-ultimate ability missile: [[File:Mel_Original_SFX_WReflect_Normal_buffactivate.ogg]] ** Ultimate ability missile: [[File:Mel_Original_SFX_WReflect_Ult_buffactivate.ogg]] ** Ability with global or near-global range missile: [[File:Mel_Original_SFX_WReflect_Global_buffactivate.ogg]]
